verbose.description: Verbosity level for dsh output (0 = silent, higher = more verbose)

remoteshell.description: Remote shell command to use (e.g., rsh, ssh)

showmachinenames.description: Whether to prefix output with machine names (0 = no, 1 = yes)

waitshell.description: Whether to wait for execution of remote commands to complete (0 = no, 1 = yes)
